comment: Base script (DESKTOP-WASM-001 T7), written by `cobolt-bench pixel-parity --write-scripts`: every bound event raised once, in the order of the file, with a frame after each. Raised without waiting, as they open a form modally: none. Last, as they end the form (without waiting too when a modal form is open): BTN-BACK.onClick. Answered with cancel, as they open a file dialog: none. Not raised, as they reach the network: none.
